headline: Client-side pipeline animates talking pets with in-browser segmentation & WebGL lip-syncing, no backend needed.
summary: A new entirely client-side pipeline enables real-time animated talking pets directly in the browser, featuring in-browser image segmentation, WebGL lip-syncing, and native MP4 export, eliminating server costs.
details: A developer has built an innovative, entirely client-side pipeline capable of animating talking pets. This project eliminates the need for any backend servers or GPU compute bills, performing all operations directly within the user's browser.

The pipeline incorporates in-browser image segmentation, allowing the system to isolate and process pet images locally. It also features real-time WebGL lip-syncing, which synchronizes mouth movements with audio dynamically.

Further enhancing its functionality, the tool supports native MP4 export, enabling users to save their animated creations directly from the browser. This full client-side execution makes the solution highly accessible and cost-effective for users.
